evidence.summary: In 2018 SASTIND and the Ministry of Education named XJTU a newly co-built university for 2016–2020, to support its defence-specialty disciplines, defence research bases and teams, and training for the defence industry, and to encourage it to take on military-industry research tasks.

XJTU says it has strategic cooperation with the defence-industry groups CASC, CASIC and AECC. In June 2025 it signed a strategic cooperation agreement with CASIC’s Sixth Academy, which said it hoped to work with the university on advanced materials, intelligent manufacturing and energy and power, build research platforms and train staff jointly.
XJTU describes itself as a key university run directly by the Ministry of Education.
